text:
maria: heads-up — we've got a global uptick in inference 5xx + timeouts after the 00:30 canary flip. Customers reporting timeouts and degraded throughput. attaching initial support ticket link: https://support.redwood.example/t/4892 :warning:
oncall-bot: Alert: spike in 5xx rate for hosted-api-prod (route: /v1/generate) — 6x above baseline in the last 3m. Incident ID: INC-20260317-01
alex: oncall — can you confirm canary config that went out? which flag?
jordan: it was the new "opaque-routing" config (partial routing by tenant hash) + a shedder param change (max inflight 30 -> 20) rolled to 5% canary at 00:30
maria: verified. Telemetry shows increased gateway timeouts and 502/504s, not auth failures. Some customers saw 500s from model pods returning upstream errors.
samir: repro attempt: I ran a bulk synthetic workload against canaryed route and see KV cache increases and frequent ctx.DeadlineExceeded on the runtime side. Logs show: ```rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded desc = context deadline exceeded; kvcache: miss rate spike```
alex: can you paste the curl that repros? need exact headers we use in prod (x-rdw-route, x-tenant, auth).
jordan: curl -i -X POST https://hosted-api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "x-tenant: acme" -H "x-rdw-route: opaque-v2" -d '{"input":"repeat test"}'
samir: running that with concurrency 30 shows 20-30% 502s within 60s, whereas baseline route returns <1% 5xx
eng-sre: tracing shows long queue wait on the gateway (avg queue wait jumped from 6ms -> 120ms) and downstream runtime latency also doubled.
alex: sounds like the shedder reduction plus opaque-routing mismatch created hotspots. Did the canary routing pin certain shards to small pool?
jordan: yes — opaque-routing hash landed many tenants onto a subset of nodes due to skewed tenant IDs in the test cluster. the pool couldn't absorb the load.
maria: customer impact: Support ticket ST-4892 reports 40% failed requests and one enterprise complaining about billing for failed requests. Support asked for immediate rollback and credits.
support-ops: filing billing compensations and pausing billing for impacted orgs now. I'll need the rollback window and expected ETA.
samir: rollback command ready: `kubectl -n prod set image deploy/edge-gateway edge=edge:v20260316-canary-rollback` — also need config flag flip: `rdwctl feature disable opaque-routing --env=prod`
alex: coordinate with deploy pipeline — I'm starting a controlled rollback to 0% canary and reenable steady routing. Will notify infra for capacity adjustments.
maria: notify customers in 10m with status update. Please post postmortem stub when stabilized.
oncall-bot: Deploy job started by alex at 00:45. Job: rollback/opaque-routing-canary -> 0%.
eng-sre: after rollback metrics trending back to baseline within 3 minutes — 5xx down from 6x to 1.2x, queue wait back to ~8ms.
jordan: we should add a pre-rollout tenant distribution check to catch skewed hash partitioning. also need a canary load test that replays real tenant distribution.
support-ops: updated ST-4892: credits issued for impacted requests; awaiting final confirmation from customer.
maria: root cause hypothesis: opaque-routing combined with reduced shedder inflight created tenant hot-spotting; canary rollout target mis-sampled tenants. Action items: 1) immediate rollback (done) 2) add tenant-sample distribution check to canary gating 3) revert shedder change until we have autoscale safety net 4) postmortem with timeline and impact numbers
alex: assigning tasks — @jordan for gating checks, @samir for shedder revert PR, @eng-sre for autoscale safety runbook.
samir: opening PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/742 (revert shedder-limit and add circuit breaker)
maria: thanks team. I'll update execs and close the loop with support. :thumbsup:
